description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the TextHelperService, focusing on string length, containment, start, and end checks, including multilingual strings.

classes.name: TextHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various string utility methods of TextHelperService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TextHelperService before each test.

methods.name: testStrLength
methods.description: Tests the strLength method with ASCII and Unicode strings.

methods.name: testStrStartsWith
methods.description: Tests the strStartsWith method to verify string start substrings.

methods.name: testStrEndsWith
methods.description: Tests the strEndsWith method to verify string ending substrings.
